classification: Second independent auditor repair: separate worker-preexit observation from strictly verified postexit durable main-file image
known_prior_failure: ValueError: Current closed database/WAL/SHM witness differs
limitations: The worker-preexit sidecar byte sizes are retained observations, not independently reproducible postexit artifacts.
This CPU qualification is not a complete actual-results certificate; root must run the new auditor with a new output filename.
source_explanation: The worker observes disk_closed after SQLiteIndex.close, whose implementation says connections are closed per operation and has no body. The worker also retains the empty-schema sqlite3 connection variable: entering/exiting a sqlite3 connection context manages transactions without explicit connection.close. That reference remains within worker scope when disk_closed is sampled. Native parent records clean exit and group disappearance later. Removed sidecar bytes were not retained and cannot be re-hashed. The page/header comparison independently proves retained image equality without asserting a retrospective exact WAL lifecycle.
strict_repair_checks: Require worker-preexit recorded file schema and internally consistent physical byte sum.
Require postexit physical inventory to contain only the main database with size exactly equal to final hash-bound SQLite backup and the recorded main-file size.
Compare all retained page bytes and every header byte except three separately recorded SQLite backup counter fields.
Require valid SQLite magic, page size/page count/file length, and exact final backup artifact SHA.
Preserve preexit and postexit sizes as separate labeled observations in the certificate.
Keep the prior exact raw argv/private ownership restoration repair and all original committed source guards.
